ops.title: Codex desktop routing compatibility: alpha16 and 0.156.1
ops.body: Desktop routing is a runtime response contract, not a supported config toggle. Bundled codex-cli 0.155.0-alpha.16 and isolated official 0.156.1 returned account/read.workspaceRouting with chatgptAccountId, backendOrigin=https://chatgpt.com, and accountRoutingOverride=NO_CONSTRAINT; Homebrew 0.155.1 did not. Desktop 26.917.51856 build 10492 completed a real broker WebSocket handshake with 0.156.1 and rendered its main route in a disposable profile after the shipped internal onboarding override was set in isolated state. Native SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop hooks ran on 0.156.1, and turn/start.toolOutput persisted as functionCallOutput before the exact acknowledgement and idle state. GUI-authored turn, resume, approval, and idle-versus-active feedback acceptance remain unproven because computer-use could capture but not focus the Electron webview. During testing the isolated Codex bundle entered an update exit path and moved to Trash as 26.917.62051 build 10789; the older /Applications/ChatGPT.app 26.915.31945 build 9922 remained unchanged, so no restore or install was attempted. Raw logs, copied auth, and disposable profiles were removed after preserving sanitized evidence.
